question: Does the unchanged frozen exact-ecology package retain its observed balance and identity passes while reaching the unified matrix's registered confidence-sequence precision target?

selectionRule.precision: The unified matrix must set precisionReached to true and maximumCoreHalfWidth must be at most the committed 0.12 target.
selectionRule.balance: Every three-, four-, and five-player faction, seat, profile, diversity, fallback, forced-no-op, homogeneous dominance, pairwise dominance, and adversarial bound must pass.
selectionRule.measuredDefects: Five-player winning-path entropy must remain at least 0.60, and the three-player Infrastructure Compounder plus greedy-backend cell must not appear in diagnosticDominance.
selectionRule.trustIdentity: Trust Governor must average at least one Influence selection per appearance, keep Influence below its largest Core Action, reach Trust 4 in at least 85 percent of appearances, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.capacityIdentity: Capacity Operator must average at least two Build selections per appearance, select Research plus Deploy more often than Build, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.agiIdentity: AGI Candidate must be the largest profile contributor to AGI-declaration winner credit, supply at least 30 percent of that credit overall, retain mean Mandate of at least 14, and keep Dossier as its highest Program weight.
selectionRule.infrastructureIdentity: Infrastructure Compounder must average at least two Build selections per appearance, retain mean Mandate of at least 16 at every supported count, and retain its authored Generator and two-Facility transition rules.
selectionRule.rulesBoundary: The exact four profile artifacts, physical rules, starts, actions, scoring, model, projection, and evidence contract are unchanged from holdout v1. Only seed and preregistered sample design differ.
selectionRule.promotion: A complete pass may nominate the strategy package for explicit human approval. It does not prove fun, negotiation quality, teachability, duration, or human counterplay.
selectionRule.failure: Any precision, balance, measured-defect, or identity failure rejects certification. Do not tune profiles, change rules, or escalate the sample again from this confirmation.

sampleRationale: Holdout v1 used 11,998 matches and reached maximumCoreHalfWidth 0.1895 against a 0.12 target, with the widest core family at 359 minimum exposures. A 36,000-match cap and 24-match batches provide approximately three times the observations without increasing sequential looks proportionally.
requiredDiagnostics: exact profile source paths and SHA-256 digests
complete executed ecology profiles and fingerprints
profile Action selections and Mandate sources
profile and faction win shares by supported player count
AGI emergence and winner override rates
